description: identity.rs handle_identity_set update loop uses Ok(_) => { updated.insert(id_str.clone(), Value::Null) }, discarding the Ok(Some(obj)) case. If the backend returns Some(updated_identity) to echo server-modified fields, those fields are silently dropped and the client receives null instead of the updated object. All other /set handlers in this commit were fixed to use Ok(Some(obj)) / Ok(None) pattern; Identity/set was not.
title: Identity/set update silently discards Ok(Some(obj)) echo
